findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "compass" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_map_view, compass_interviews_list, compass_interviews_get, compass_inbox_list, compass_opportunities_set_status, compass_step_claims_list, compass_transformations_respond, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: compass_pages_list, compass_pages_create, compass_links_create, compass_interview_targets, compass_gaps_create, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_opportunities_create, compass_opportunities_mark_implemented, compass_opportunities_delete, compass_workflow_steps, compass_step_claims_propose, compass_transformations_respond, search_workspace · Public sink: compass_pages_update, compass_interviews_create, compass_interview_targets, compass_workflow_rollup, compass_change_effects_set · Destructive: compass_interviews_create, compass_pages_delete, compass_pages_restore, compass_links_update, compass_links_delete, compass_opportunities_delete, compass_workflow_rollup, compass_step_measures_propose, compass_priority_steps_find, compass_changes_upsert, comments_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_map_view, compass_interviews_list, compass_interviews_get, compass_inbox_list, compass_opportunities_set_status, compass_step_claims_list, compass_transformations_respond, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: compass_pages_list, compass_pages_create, compass_links_create, compass_interview_targets, compass_gaps_create, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_opportunities_create, compass_opportunities_mark_implemented, compass_opportunities_delete, compass_workflow_steps, compass_step_claims_propose, compass_transformations_respond, search_workspace · Public sink: compass_pages_update, compass_interviews_create, compass_interview_targets, compass_workflow_rollup, compass_change_effects_set · Destructive: compass_interviews_create, compass_pages_delete, compass_pages_restore, compass_links_update, compass_links_delete, compass_opportunities_delete, compass_workflow_rollup, compass_step_measures_propose, compass_priority_steps_find, compass_changes_upsert, comments_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
